## About
Pettey's Auto Service is a second-generation, family-owned shop in Rancho Bernardo. Some of today's customers first came to us because their parents were Dad's customers, and we still work the same way: build a relationship with you and keep you safe on the road.
Our ASE-Certified technicians work on foreign and domestic vehicles, from routine maintenance to brakes and diagnostics. Neighbors have given us a 4.8 rating across 74 Google reviews, and we'd like to earn your trust too.

## Services
- Vehicle maintenance: Affordable routine care to keep your car running safely.
- Factory recommended maintenance: Service that follows your vehicle maker's recommended schedule.
- Brake repair: Prompt brake work so you can stop with confidence.
- Auto diagnostics: Modern diagnostic tools to find the real cause of the problem.

## FAQ
Q: Do you work on foreign cars?
A: Yes. We maintain and repair both domestic and foreign vehicles.

Q: How do I schedule service?
A: You can request service online or call us directly at 858-485-7820.
